title: Grade 3 French — Tue, Jun 10
description: La famille — Day 2 of 5: Extended family members
subject: french

questions.question: How do you say 'uncle' in French?
questions.explanation: 'L'oncle' = uncle. 'Mon oncle s'appelle David.' = My uncle is called David.

questions.question: How do you say 'aunt' in French?
questions.explanation: 'La tante' = aunt. 'Ma tante habite à Paris.' = My aunt lives in Paris.

questions.question: What is 'un cousin' in English?
questions.explanation: 'Un cousin' = a male cousin. 'J'ai deux cousins.' = I have two cousins (male).

questions.question: What is 'une cousine' in English?
questions.explanation: 'Une cousine' = a female cousin. 'Ma cousine a dix ans.' = My cousin (f.) is ten years old.

questions.question: How do you say 'nephew' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Le neveu' = nephew. 'Mon neveu s'appelle Rohan.' = My nephew is called Rohan.

questions.question: How do you say 'niece' in French?
questions.explanation: 'La nièce' = niece. 'Ma nièce est adorable.' = My niece is adorable.

questions.question: What is 'les grands-parents' in English?
questions.explanation: 'Les grands-parents' = the grandparents. 'Mes grands-parents habitent à Lucknow.' = My grandparents live in Lucknow.

questions.question: Complete: 'Le fils de mon oncle est mon ___.'
questions.explanation: The son of your uncle = your cousin. 'Le fils de mon oncle est mon cousin.'

questions.question: What is 'la belle-mère' in English?
questions.explanation: 'La belle-mère' = stepmother or mother-in-law. Context determines which meaning.

questions.question: How do you say 'I have a big family' in French?
questions.explanation: 'J'ai une grande famille.' = I have a big family. 'Grande' = big/large.

questions.question: What does 'la famille élargie' mean?
questions.explanation: 'La famille élargie' = the extended family — including uncles, aunts, cousins, grandparents.

questions.question: Complete: 'J'ai une tante et ___ oncle.'
questions.explanation: 'J'ai une tante et un oncle.' 'Oncle' is masculine → 'un'.

questions.question: Translate: 'My uncle and my aunt have three children.'
options: Mon oncle et ma tante ont trois enfants.
Mon oncle et ma tante a trois enfants.
Mon oncle et ma tante ont trois fils.
L'oncle et la tante ont des enfants.
questions.explanation: 'Mon oncle et ma tante ont trois enfants.' = My uncle and aunt have three children.

questions.question: What is the relationship? 'La fille de ma tante est ma ___.'
questions.explanation: The daughter of your aunt = your cousin (female). 'La fille de ma tante est ma cousine.'

questions.question: How do you ask 'How many people are in your family?' in French?
options: Combien de personnes y a-t-il dans ta famille?
questions.explanation: 'Combien de personnes y a-t-il dans ta famille?' = How many people are in your family?
